Making God the direct creator and determiner of human unbelief compromises divine justice in punishing the lost, contrary to God's revealed desire that the wicked turn and live rather than perish ([Ezekiel 18:23](bible://ez/18/23), [Matthew 23:37](bible://mt/23/37)).

65:4.Devalues Women: Prescribes a three-month post-divorce waiting period (*'iddah*) for wives "who have not (yet) menstruated" (*wa-allati lam yahidna*), alongside postmenopausal and pregnant women. Because an *'iddah* is legally required only after a marriage has been sexually consummated ([Quran 33:49](quran://33/49)), this verse explicitly codifies consummated marriage and divorce of prepubescent girls—unanimously affirmed in [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 65:4](ibnkathir://65/4) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 65:4](tabari://65/4) as "the young, who have not reached the years of menstruation," and exemplified by Muhammad's marriage to Aisha at six and consummation at nine ([Sahih al-Bukhari 5133](/hadith/bukhari/5133), [Sahih Muslim 1422a](/hadith/muslim/1422a), [Sahih al-Bukhari 6130](/hadith/bukhari/6130)).

65:12.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Declares that Allah "created seven heavens, and of the earth a similar (number) to them," embedding ancient Near Eastern layered-earth cosmology rather than a single spherical planet. Both [Tafsir al-Tabari 65:12](tabari://65/12) and [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 65:12](ibnkathir://65/12)—citing [Sahih al-Bukhari 3198](https://sunnah.com/bukhari:3198) ("sink down to the seven earths") and Companion traditions describing seven stacked earths separated by five-hundred-year distances—explicitly reject "seven continents" reinterpretations as contradicting the plain text of the Quran and Sunnah.

66:1.Self-Serving Revelations & Prophetic Pri: Chides Muhammad for forbidding himself what Allah permitted merely to please his wives—revealed, per [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 66:1](ibnkathir://66/1), [Tafsir al-Tabari 66:1](tabari://66/1), [Sahih al-Bukhari 4912](/hadith/bukhari/4912), [Sahih al-Bukhari 5267](/hadith/bukhari/5267), and [Sahih Muslim 1474a](/hadith/muslim/1474a), either after Hafsa caught Muhammad on her bed with his slave concubine Mariyah the Copt or after Aisha and Hafsa protested his honey visits with Zaynab. Deploying divine revelation to overrule Muhammad's own domestic concession prioritizes his personal gratifications over his wives' grievances.
66:1.Sanctions Slavery & Concubinage: In the primary occasion of revelation transmitted from Ibn 'Abbas, 'Umar, Anas, Masruq, and Zayd ibn Aslam in [Tafsir al-Tabari 66:1](tabari://66/1) and [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 66:1](ibnkathir://66/1), "what God has permitted to you" refers directly to Muhammad's sexual relations with his enslaved Coptic concubine Mariyah outside marriage. Treating sexual access to an enslaved female captive as a divinely protected prophetic right conflicts directly with the biblical standard of exclusive, lifelong monogamous marriage ([Genesis 2:24](bible://gn/2/24), [Matthew 19:5](bible://mt/19/5), [Hebrews 13:4](bible://heb/13/4)).

66:2.Self-Serving Revelations & Prophetic Pri: Immediately releases Muhammad from the sworn oath he made to appease Hafsa ([Quran 66:1](quran://66/1)) by invoking statutory oath-absolution (*tahillata aymanikum*, [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 66:2](ibnkathir://66/2), [Tafsir al-Tabari 66:2](tabari://66/2)), enabling him to resume relations with Mariyah or drinking honey without honouring his pledge to his wives.
66:2.Theological Defect: Codifies legal expiation to dissolve sworn oaths whenever a preferable option appears—generalized by Muhammad in [Sahih al-Bukhari 6722](/hadith/bukhari/6722) and [Sahih al-Bukhari 6623](/hadith/bukhari/6623) alongside [Quran 5:89](quran://5/89) into a standing rule to break an oath via *kaffarah* whenever one sees something better. Permitting calculated oath-breaking undermines the sacredness of vows upheld across Scripture, where a person must not break his word ([Numbers 30:2](bible://nm/30/2), [Psalms 15:4](bible://ps/15/4), [Matthew 5:33](bible://mt/5/33)).

66:3.Self-Serving Revelations & Prophetic Pri: Devotes eternal scripture to adjudicating a private household leak—recounting how Muhammad confided a secret oath to Hafsa regarding Mariyah the Copt or honey, how she told Aisha, and how Allah alerted Muhammad to confront her ([Tafsir al-Tabari 66:3](tabari://66/3), [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 66:3](ibnkathir://66/3), [Sahih al-Bukhari 5267](/hadith/bukhari/5267), [Sahih al-Bukhari 6691](/hadith/bukhari/6691)). Enlisting divine omniscience to police domestic conversations among Muhammad's wives exemplifies revelation tailored to his private household management.

66:4.Self-Serving Revelations & Prophetic Pri: Orders Hafsa and Aisha to repent for backing each other in jealousy against Muhammad and warns them that Allah Himself, Gabriel, the righteous believers, and all the angels stand arrayed as Muhammad's personal protectors against two complaining wives ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 66:4](ibnkathir://66/4), [Tafsir al-Tabari 66:4](tabari://66/4), [Sahih al-Bukhari 2468](https://sunnah.com/bukhari:2468), [Sahih al-Bukhari 4912](/hadith/bukhari/4912), [Sahih al-Bukhari 4913](https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4913), [Sahih Muslim 1479a](/hadith/muslim/1479a)). Mobilizing the Creator and heavenly hosts to intimidate two wives in a domestic dispute subordinates divine majesty to Muhammad's marital authority.

66:5.Self-Serving Revelations & Prophetic Pri: Threatens Muhammad's wives that if he divorces them, his Lord will replace them with more compliant widows and virgins—a verse revealed verbatim matching 'Umar ibn al-Khattab's prior verbal threat when scolding Muhammad's wives on his behalf ([Sahih al-Bukhari 402](/hadith/bukhari/402), [Sahih al-Bukhari 4483](/hadith/bukhari/4483), [Sahih al-Bukhari 4913](https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4913), [Tafsir al-Tabari 66:5](tabari://66/5), [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 66:5](ibnkathir://66/5)). Adopting 'Umar's partisan domestic ultimatum word-for-word as divine revelation underscores the ad-hoc, self-serving character of the passage.
66:5.Devalues Women: Coerces Muhammad's wives into domestic submission under threat of mass divorce and replacement by "better wives" defined by obedience and categorized by sexual history as "previously married and virgins" (*thayyibatin wa-abkaran*, [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 66:5](ibnkathir://66/5), [Tafsir al-Tabari 66:5](tabari://66/5)). Treating wives as replaceable dependents contrasts sharply with the biblical summons for husbands to love their wives sacrificially as Christ loved the Church ([Ephesians 5:25](bible://eph/5/25), [Malachi 2:14](bible://mal/2/14)).

66:9.Incites Violence & Intolerance: Commands the Prophet to wage *jihad* against disbelievers and hypocrites and "be stern (*wa-ghluz*) with them," explicitly defined in [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 66:9](ibnkathir://66/9) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 66:9](tabari://66/9) (paralleling [Quran 9:73](quran://9/73)) as fighting non-Muslims "with weapons and armaments" and "with the sword" while enforcing severe penal punishments on hypocrites. Mandating armed warfare and harshness toward religious outsiders directly opposes the New Testament call to love enemies, bless persecutors, and embody peaceable gentleness ([Matthew 5:44](bible://mt/5/44), [Romans 12:14](bible://rom/12/14), [James 3:17](bible://jas/3/17)).

66:10.Contradicts the Bible: Condemns Noah's wife alongside Lot's wife as an unbelieving traitor ordered to "Enter the Fire," explained in [Tafsir al-Tabari 66:10](tabari://66/10) and [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 66:10](ibnkathir://66/10) as Noah's wife rejecting his message and telling people he was a madman. This directly contradicts both Genesis and the New Testament, where Noah's wife enters the Ark under God's saving covenant alongside Noah and exits delivered safely with his household through the Flood ([Genesis 6:18](bible://gn/6/18), [Genesis 7:13](bible://gn/7/13), [Genesis 8:18](bible://gn/8/18), [Hebrews 11:7](bible://heb/11/7)).

66:12.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Identifies Mary, the 1st-century BC/AD mother of Jesus, as "Mary, daughter of 'Imran" (*Maryama ibnata 'Imrana*)—paired with [Quran 19:28](quran://19/28) addressing her as "sister of Aaron" and [Quran 3:35](quran://3/35) making 'Imran's wife her biological mother ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 66:12](ibnkathir://66/12); [Sahih Muslim 2135](/hadith/muslim/2135)). This conflates Jesus's mother Mary across roughly fourteen centuries with Mosaic Miriam (both *Maryam* in Arabic), the historical daughter of Amram ('Imran) and sister of Aaron and Moses in [Numbers 26:59](bible://nm/26/59) and [Exodus 15:20](bible://ex/15/20).
66:12.Concedes Christian & Biblical Truths: Explicitly affirms Mary's lifelong virginal chastity, her miraculous conception of Jesus when God breathed of His Spirit (*min ruhina*) into her, and her devout confirmation of her Lord's Words and Scriptures—glossed by Qatadah in [Tafsir al-Tabari 66:12](tabari://66/12) as believing in Jesus as God's Word and in the Torah and Gospel ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 66:12](ibnkathir://66/12)). This upholds the historic Virgin Birth and Mary's faithful submission proclaimed in [Luke 1:35](bible://lk/1/35) and [Luke 1:38](bible://lk/1/38).

67:3.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Asserts that Allah created 'seven heavens in layers (tibaqan)' stacked one above another and challenges observers to look up and find any crack or fissure in the overhead canopy ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 67:3](ibnkathir://67/3), [Tafsir al-Tabari 67:3](tabari://67/3)). This reflects ancient Near Eastern cosmology of seven solid stacked sky-domes rather than the continuous vacuum of space established by modern astronomy.

67:5.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Declares that Allah adorned the lowest of the seven heavens with 'lamps' (masabih, stars) and made them physical 'missiles for the satans' (rujuman lil-shayatin), as confirmed in [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 67:5](ibnkathir://67/5), [Tafsir al-Tabari 67:5](tabari://67/5), [Sahih al-Bukhari 4921](/hadith/bukhari/4921), and [Sahih Muslim 2229a](/hadith/muslim/2229a). This conflates massive thermonuclear stars situated light-years across the universe with small meteoroids burning up inside Earth's upper atmosphere.

68:13.Theological Defect: Attacks a Meccan opponent—identified in [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 68:13](ibnkathir://68/13) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 68:13](tabari://68/13) as al-Walid ibn al-Mughirah or al-Akhnas ibn Shariq—by stigmatizing him in eternal scripture as an illegitimate 'bastard' (zanim). Shaming a person for the circumstances of his parents' union stands in moral tension with the principle that no soul bears the sin of another ([Quran 6:164](quran://6/164), [Ezekiel 18:20](bible://ez/18/20)).

69:46.Failed Prophecy: Establishes a divine falsification test across [Quran 69:44](quran://69/44) through [Quran 69:46](quran://69/46), declaring that if Muhammad fabricated false revelations against Allah, Allah would seize him and sever his aorta (al-watin, defined as the heart's main life-artery in [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 69:46](ibnkathir://69/46) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 69:46](tabari://69/46)). Yet after eating poisoned mutton at Khaybar ([Sahih Muslim 2190a](/hadith/muslim/2190a)), Muhammad testified on his deathbed in [Sahih al-Bukhari 4428](https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4428) that he felt his aorta being severed ('this is the time when my aorta [abhari] is being cut') from that poison, dying with the exact lethal symptom specified here for a false prophet.
69:46.Theological Defect: Frames divine vindication of true prophethood around immunity from dying via a severed life-artery (al-watin, [Tafsir al-Tabari 69:46](tabari://69/46)), creating an internal theological crisis within Islamic tradition when canonical reports in [Sahih al-Bukhari 4428](https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4428) and [Sahih Muslim 2190a](/hadith/muslim/2190a) record Muhammad attributing his fatal illness to the Khaybar poison severing his aorta.

70:4.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: States that angels and the Spirit ascend to Allah in a day measuring fifty thousand years—which [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 70:4](ibnkathir://70/4) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 70:4](tabari://70/4) report early exegetes interpreted either as the physical travel distance across seven earths and seven solid heavens or as Judgment Day—creating an unresolved numerical discrepancy with [Quran 32:5](quran://32/5), where divine affairs ascend to Him in a day measuring one thousand years.

70:30.Sanctions Slavery & Concubinage: Qualifies the command to guard chastity in [Quran 70:29](quran://70/29) by explicitly exempting both wives and enslaved females ('what their right hands own,' ma malakat aymanuhum), declaring male owners completely blameless (ghayru malumin) for sexual relations with captive or purchased slave women outside marriage ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 70:30](ibnkathir://70/30), [Tafsir al-Tabari 70:30](tabari://70/30), cf. [Quran 23:6](quran://23/6)).
70:30.Devalues Women: Institutionalizes a permanent sexual asymmetry in which enslaved females are legally grouped alongside wives as permissible sexual outlets for their male masters without marriage contract, bridal dower, or reciprocal consent, while denying women any equivalent right ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 70:30](ibnkathir://70/30), [Tafsir al-Tabari 70:30](tabari://70/30)).

71:15.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Places into Noah's preaching the ancient Near Eastern cosmological model of 'seven heavens in layers' (sab'a samawatin tibaqan), interpreted in [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 71:15](ibnkathir://71/15) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 71:15](tabari://71/15) as seven distinct concentric domes stacked one above another, incompatible with modern observational astronomy.

71:16.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Asserts that Allah placed the moon 'in them' (fihinna—inside the seven layered heavens of [Quran 71:15](quran://71/15)) as an intrinsic light (nuran) and the sun as a lamp ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 71:16](ibnkathir://71/16), [Tafsir al-Tabari 71:16](tabari://71/16)), whereas the moon is an opaque rocky body reflecting sunlight and stars exist billions of light-years beyond the Earth-Moon system.

71:19.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Describes Allah making the earth a flat spread-out carpet or mat (bisatan) so humans may traverse its wide paths in [Quran 71:20](quran://71/20) ([Tafsir al-Tabari 71:19](tabari://71/19), [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 71:19](ibnkathir://71/19)), employing the same flat-plane spatial imagery found in [Quran 78:6](quran://78/6) and [Quran 88:20](quran://88/20).

71:23.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Anachronistically places five documented pre-Islamic Arabian tribal deities—Wadd, Suwa', Yaghuth, Ya'uq, and Nasr, attested in Arabian epigraphy and catalogued as 7th-century AD Arab tribal idols of Kalb, Hudhayl, Murad, Hamdan, and Himyar in [Sahih al-Bukhari 4920](https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4920), [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 71:23](ibnkathir://71/23), and [Tafsir al-Tabari 71:23](tabari://71/23)—into the mouths of Noah's antediluvian contemporaries thousands of years earlier, with no basis in [Genesis 6:5](bible://gn/6/5).

72:3.Contradicts the Bible: Attributes to listening jinn the polemical denial that God has taken 'a female consort (sahibah) or a son (walad)' ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 72:3](ibnkathir://72/3), [Tafsir al-Tabari 72:3](tabari://72/3)), conflating divine Sonship with physical procreation alongside a female partner (cf. [Quran 6:101](quran://6/101)) while rejecting the eternal spiritual Sonship of Christ taught in [John 1:18](bible://jn/1/18) and [Hebrews 1:2](bible://heb/1/2).

72:8.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Portrays jinn physically reaching and touching a solid sky ceiling ('we touched the sky') and finding it guarded by angels and fiery meteors (shuhuban), as explained in [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 72:8](ibnkathir://72/8), [Tafsir al-Tabari 72:8](tabari://72/8), and [Sahih al-Bukhari 4921](/hadith/bukhari/4921), misidentifying natural interplanetary dust burning in Earth's mesosphere as supernatural projectiles defending a solid firmament.

72:9.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Claims—as affirmed historically in [Sahih al-Bukhari 4921](/hadith/bukhari/4921), [Sahih Muslim 449](/hadith/muslim/449), [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 72:9](ibnkathir://72/9), and [Tafsir al-Tabari 72:9](tabari://72/9)—that jinn formerly sat freely on heavenly listening perches until shooting-star missiles began barring them at Muhammad's prophetic commissioning, contradicting extensive Chinese, Greek, and Roman astronomical records documenting regular meteor showers centuries before the 7th century AD.

74:31.Theological Defect: Declares that Allah set the number of Hell's angelic wardens at nineteen specifically 'as a trial (fitnah) for those who disbelieve' and affirms that 'God leads astray (yudillu) whomever He pleases, and guides whomever He pleases' ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 74:31](ibnkathir://74/31), [Tafsir al-Tabari 74:31](tabari://74/31)), depicting God as designing revelations to stumble souls into error, contrary to [James 1:13](bible://jas/1/13).

75:38.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: States that after beginning as an emitted drop of semen in [Quran 75:37](quran://75/37), the human conceptus becomes a congealed blood-clot ('alaqah, defined as clotted blood in [Tafsir al-Tabari 75:38](tabari://75/38), [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 75:38](ibnkathir://75/38), [Sahih al-Bukhari 3208](/hadith/bukhari/3208), and [Sahih Muslim 2643a](/hadith/muslim/2643a)) before being fashioned into male and female in [Quran 75:39](quran://75/39), whereas human embryos never form from clotted blood and biological sex is determined chromosomally at fertilization.

76:30.Theological Defect: Negates autonomous human moral choice by declaring, 'But you will not will unless God wills,' which [Tafsir al-Tabari 76:30](tabari://76/30) and [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 76:30](ibnkathir://76/30) interpret as establishing that no person can choose guidance unless Allah wills it first, creating a severe moral tension when [Quran 76:31](quran://76/31) consigns people to painful torment for failing to will what Allah withheld.

78:6.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Depicts the earth as a flat spread-out resting bed or cradle (mihadan, [Tafsir al-Tabari 78:6](tabari://78/6), [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 78:6](ibnkathir://78/6)), paired directly with the tent-peg mountains of [Quran 78:7](quran://78/7) in an ancient flat-earth tent cosmology.

78:7.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Describes mountains as tent-pegs or stakes (awtadan) driven down to anchor the earth against shaking ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 78:7](ibnkathir://78/7), [Tafsir al-Tabari 78:7](tabari://78/7), cf. [Quran 16:15](quran://16/15)), contradicting modern geology, which demonstrates that mountains are not pegs driven from above and instead form along tectonic collision and fault zones that generate seismic activity rather than prevent earthquakes.

78:12.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Asserts that Allah built 'above you seven firm heavens' (sab'an shidadan), which [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 78:12](ibnkathir://78/12) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 78:12](tabari://78/12) explain as seven solid, massive architectural domes thick enough to resist cracking until physically swung open like gates in [Quran 78:19](quran://78/19).

78:33.Devalues Women: Promises righteous men 'full-breasted maidens, all of the same age' (kawa'iba atraban, defined in [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 78:33](ibnkathir://78/33) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 78:33](tabari://78/33) as young virgins with firm, round, non-sagging breasts), reducing female existence in Paradise to anatomically specified sexual companions created for male pleasure.
78:33.Theological Defect: Frames eternal salvation in [Quran 78:31](quran://78/31) through [Quran 78:34](quran://78/34) around carnal gratification—orchards, overflowing cups, and 'full-breasted maidens of the same age' ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 78:33](ibnkathir://78/33))—contrasting sharply with Jesus's teaching in [Matthew 22:30](bible://mt/22/30) and [Romans 14:17](bible://rom/14/17) that the resurrection transcends sexual marriage and centers on righteousness, peace, and communion with God.

79:30.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: States that after building the sky, raising its vault, and bringing forth its night and morning light in [Quran 79:27](quran://79/27) through [Quran 79:29](quran://79/29), Allah 'after that (ba'da dhalika) spread out (dahaha) the earth' and anchored its mountains in [Quran 79:32](quran://79/32). Beyond using flat-plane spreading terminology, placing Earth's formation and mountains after earthly night and daylight conflicts directly with [Quran 2:29](quran://2/29) and [Quran 41:9](quran://41/9) through [Quran 41:12](quran://41/12), forcing strained harmonizations in [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 79:30](ibnkathir://79/30) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 79:30](tabari://79/30).

81:29.Theological Defect: Immediately overrides the apparent human choice offered in [Quran 81:28](quran://81/28) ('to whoever of you pleases to go straight') by decreeing, 'But you will not please unless God pleases,' which [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 81:29](ibnkathir://81/29) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 81:29](tabari://81/29) cite to refute human free-will theology while holding humans eternally culpable for unbelief.

86:6.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Declares that the human being was created from 'spurting water' (ma'in dafiq), unanimously identified in [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 86:6](ibnkathir://86/6) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 86:6](tabari://86/6) as ejaculated semen (mani), which refutes modern attempts to rescue [Quran 86:7](quran://86/7) via embryonic gonadal descent because embryonic gonads never emit spurting ejaculate.

86:7.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Asserts that the spurting reproductive fluid of [Quran 86:6](quran://86/6) emerges 'from between the spine (al-sulb) and the ribs (al-tara'ib),' defined across [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 86:7](ibnkathir://86/7) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 86:7](tabari://86/7) as the male backbone and the chest or breastbones. This mirrors ancient Hippocratic theories that semen descends from the brain through the spinal cord, whereas sperm are produced in the scrotal testes and seminal fluid in the pelvic seminal vesicles and prostate gland, nowhere between the spine and ribcage.

86:16.Theological Defect: Attributes scheming plots ('but I too am hatching a plot,' wa-akidu kaydan) directly to Allah's character, which [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 86:16](ibnkathir://86/16) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 86:16](tabari://86/16) explain as gradually luring disbelievers into destruction from directions they do not perceive (istidraj), paralleling [Quran 3:54](quran://3/54) and [Quran 8:30](quran://8/30).

87:6.Theological Defect: Qualifies Allah's promise to preserve Muhammad's recitation with the open-ended exception, 'We shall make you recite, and you will not forget—except whatever God pleases,' which [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 87:6](ibnkathir://87/6) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 87:6](tabari://87/6) link to divine abrogation and erased verses, corroborated by [Sahih al-Bukhari 5037](/hadith/bukhari/5037), [Sahih al-Bukhari 5042](/hadith/bukhari/5042), and [Sahih Muslim 788a](/hadith/muslim/788a) where Muhammad admitted forgetting revealed Quranic verses until reminded by a mosque reciter.

88:20.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Directs human observers to look at 'the earth, how it was spread flat (sutihat),' employing the passive verb from sath (a flat plane or level rooftop), which [Tafsir al-Tabari 88:20](tabari://88/20) and [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 88:20](ibnkathir://88/20) explain as leveled and spread out beneath the raised dome of the sky in [Quran 88:18](quran://88/18), reflecting ancient flat-earth observation.

91:8.Theological Defect: Swears by God fashioning the human soul and instilling into it 'its depravity (fujuraha) and its piety (taqwaha),' a verse Muhammad cites directly in [Sahih Muslim 2650](/hadith/muslim/2650) (cf. [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 91:8](ibnkathir://91/8), [Tafsir al-Tabari 91:8](tabari://91/8)) to teach that human wickedness and obedience are pre-ordained by divine decree prior to human action, standing in sharp opposition to [James 1:13](bible://jas/1/13).

92:10.Theological Defect: Declares concerning the condemned soul, 'We shall ease him to hardship,' which Muhammad explicitly invokes in [Sahih al-Bukhari 4947](/hadith/bukhari/4947) and [Sahih Muslim 2647c](/hadith/muslim/2647c) ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 92:10](ibnkathir://92/10)) to affirm that every person's final place in Paradise or Hellfire is pre-written and that Allah actively facilitates damned souls toward sin and ruin.

95:3.Failed Prophecy: Swears by Mecca as 'this secure land' (hadha al-balad al-amin), which [Tafsir al-Tabari 95:3](tabari://95/3) and [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 95:3](ibnkathir://95/3) explicitly define as Mecca being safe from enemy invasion and warfare within its sanctuary (cf. [Quran 28:57](quran://28/57), [Quran 29:67](quran://29/67)). History repeatedly falsified this sanctuary guarantee through the Umayyad catapult sieges of AD 683 and AD 692, the AD 930 Qarmatian invasion that slaughtered thousands of pilgrims inside the Haram and carried off the Black Stone for over two decades, and the AD 1979 Grand Mosque siege.

96:2.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Proclaims that God 'creates the human from a clot ('alaq),' unanimously defined across [Tafsir al-Tabari 96:2](tabari://96/2), [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 96:2](ibnkathir://96/2), [Sahih al-Bukhari 318](/hadith/bukhari/318), and [Sahih al-Bukhari 3208](/hadith/bukhari/3208) as congealed blood (dam jamid), perpetuating pre-modern Greek and Near Eastern misconceptions that embryos form from coagulated blood rather than cellular division of a fertilized ovum.

98:6.Promotes Division & Discrimination: Condemns non-Muslim Jews and Christians ('those who disbelieve among the People of the Book') alongside polytheists to eternal Hellfire and pronounces them 'the worst of creatures' (sharr al-bariyyah, [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 98:6](ibnkathir://98/6), [Tafsir al-Tabari 98:6](tabari://98/6)), ranking non-Muslims below animals in stark opposition to the universal dignity of every human being created in God's image ([Genesis 1:27](bible://gn/1/27)).

105:3.Historical, Scientific & Cosmological Er: Claims Allah annihilated the Abyssinian army of the Elephant—traditionally linked in [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 105:3](ibnkathir://105/3) and [Tafsir al-Tabari 105:3](tabari://105/3) to Abraha's alleged AD 570 march on Mecca—by sending flocks of birds pelting them with baked clay stones in [Quran 105:4](quran://105/4), whereas contemporary 6th-century South Arabian inscriptions (including Abraha's Murayghan inscription Ry 506 of ca. AD 552) record Abraha's central Arabian campaign ending in triumph and Abraha returning alive to rule Yemen for years afterward with zero epigraphic or Byzantine record of his army's destruction at Mecca.

108:3.Theological Defect: Responds to Meccan critics such as al-'As ibn Wa'il—who called Muhammad al-abtar ('cut off' without surviving sons) after his infant son died—by retorting in eternal scripture, 'Surely your hater, he is the one cut off!' ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 108:3](ibnkathir://108/3), [Tafsir al-Tabari 108:3](tabari://108/3)). Because al-'As ibn Wa'il's male line flourished through prominent sons like 'Amr ibn al-'As while all of Muhammad's biological sons died in childhood, commentators had to redefine al-abtar metaphorically as cut off from spiritual remembrance.

111:1.Theological Defect: Devotes supposedly eternal, uncreated scripture to pronouncing a personal curse of ruin upon Muhammad's paternal uncle Abu Lahab ('The hands of Abu Lahab have perished, and he has perished') after Abu Lahab told Muhammad at Mount Safa, 'May you perish, is this why you gathered us?' ([Sahih Muslim 208a](/hadith/muslim/208a), [Sahih al-Bukhari 4971](https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4971), [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 111:1](ibnkathir://111/1), [Tafsir al-Tabari 111:1](tabari://111/1)), contrasting sharply with Christ's command to bless those who curse you in [Luke 6:28](bible://lk/6/28) and [Romans 12:14](bible://rom/12/14).

111:4.Theological Defect: Extends the personal invective against Abu Lahab to his wife Umm Jamil, ridiculing her in timeless liturgy as 'the carrier of the firewood' with a palm-fiber rope around her neck in [Quran 111:5](quran://111/5) for spreading rumors or strewing thorns in Muhammad's path ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 111:4](ibnkathir://111/4), [Tafsir al-Tabari 111:4](tabari://111/4)).

112:3.Contradicts the Bible: Categorically declares that God 'has not begotten and was not begotten' (lam yalid wa-lam yulad, [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 112:3](ibnkathir://112/3), [Tafsir al-Tabari 112:3](tabari://112/3)), directly repudiating the foundational biblical revelation of God the Father and Jesus Christ as His eternally begotten Son ([Psalms 2:7](bible://ps/2/7), [John 1:18](bible://jn/1/18), [John 3:16](bible://jn/3/16), [Hebrews 1:5](bible://heb/1/5)).

113:1.Theological Defect: Opens the first of the two refuge-seeking incantations (al-Mu'awwidhatayn, alongside [Quran 114:1](quran://114/1)) that senior companion Abdullah ibn Mas'ud—one of the four foremost Quran teachers commended by Muhammad—refused to include in his Quranic codex (mushaf), erasing them on the ground that they were protective prayers rather than revealed Quranic surahs, as documented in [Sahih al-Bukhari 4977](/hadith/bukhari/4977) and [Tafsir Ibn Kathir 113:1](ibnkathir://113/1).

113:4.Theological Defect: Commands Muhammad to seek refuge 'from the evil of the women who blow on knots,' referring to knot-tying sorcery ([Tafsir Ibn Kathir 113:4](ibnkathir://113/4), [Tafsir al-Tabari 113:4](tabari://113/4)), which canonical reports in [Sahih al-Bukhari 3175](/hadith/bukhari/3175), [Sahih al-Bukhari 5763](/hadith/bukhari/5763), and [Sahih al-Bukhari 5765](/hadith/bukhari/5765) connect to Labid ibn al-A'sam bewitching Muhammad with knotted hair so that he hallucinated performing actions he had not actually done, in contrast to biblical apostles before whom sorcerers were powerless ([Acts 13:8](bible://acts/13/8)).
